rdf:Description.dc:title: Slave Coffle, House of J.W. Neal & Co, Washington, DC
rdf:Description.dc:description: This image of slaves chained together marching from the House of J.W. Neal & Co.in Washington, DC, was published in a broadside (or poster). The broadside was printed during an abolitionist campaign in 1835-36 designed to pressure Congress to end slavery in the nation's capital.
rdf:Description.dc:source: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division. View original.
